finalText:
It's building clean now. Exit code 0, "0 errors."

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler hands options as `retryCount`. That was crashing the build with a `TypeError` (`undefined.toFixed`).
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated any flag value that wasn't strictly `true` or `false` as an error. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it was throwing on that too.

Fixed both: `resolveRetries` now reads `retryCount`, and `isBackoffEnabled` treats anything other than `true` as disabled instead of throwing.

The rest of the warnings, deprecation notices, tree-shaking notes, are just noise from the bump and still show up (8 of them), same as before. Build finishes in 44.9s with 0 errors.
